scope: Source consistency, original-file preservation and actual HTTP reader behavior before publication; not a historical-priority or legal determination.
review: Desktop and mobile screenshots inspected. These checks use a real localhost HTTP origin in GitHub Actions, not set_content or a mocked reader.
publication: Actual public-origin verification is a separate read-only workflow after the Cloudflare publisher completes. This receipt does not claim that subsequent result.
artifactRetention: The workflow artifact has limited retention; this receipt and its hashes remain in Git history. The public corpus is stored in repository files, not only in an expiring workflow artifact.
